title.quote: Transductive Learning for Textual Few-Shot Classification in API-based Embedding Models
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper
title.value: Transductive Learning for Textual Few-Shot Classification in API-based Embedding Models

extractions.description: The paper proposes an API-based few-shot text classification scenario where only a black-box encoder's embeddings are available, introduces a parameter-free transductive regularizer based on the Fisher-Rao distance, and benchmarks inductive and transductive few-shot classifiers over eight datasets, four languages and ten backbone encoders with episodic evaluation over 1,000 episodes.

type.quote: We evaluate our methods using eight backbone models, along with an episodic evaluation over 1,000 episodes, which demonstrate the superiority of transductive inference over the standard inductive setting.
type.justification: The paper builds a benchmark and runs extensive experiments, although it also includes a proposition with proof
